# STM32H743 AIO Flight Controller + 80 A 4-in-1 ESC (Job #72): Architecture and Mathematical Model

## 0. Architecture Clarifications

**1. Partitioning.** The STM32H743 is the flight controller MCU. The 48 kHz PWM is generated by the four ESC MCUs (typically AT32F421 or STM32G071 running AM32 or BLHeli_32), one per motor. The H743 only emits DShot600 and receives bi-directional eRPM telemetry. The model below covers both domains.

**2. Physical feasibility.** An "80 A burst, all four channels, nano form factor" rating is thermally a 1–2 second rating, not 10 seconds (§3.4). The numbers below show where the limit actually sits.

**3. Baseline assumptions.** Every result is parametric. Substitute your datasheet values before any design review.
